in order to make it work you need to invest a lot of time typically a lot of money

textual.context: Promotional presentation by the speaker; the supplied records do not establish whether the claims are independently supported.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised financial return is linked to implementing a system that requires investing money and other resources.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify the required amount, recipient, transaction process, or actual outcomes.

textual.observation: OneCoin is promoted through an education programme in which education packages provide free OneTokens for exchange trading and possible profit.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish package prices, exchange operation, token value, or whether any participant profited.

visual.observation: A suited presenter is shown with cryptocurrency imagery and on-screen claims including “PROFITABLE,” “23%,” and “IF YOU WANT TO PROFIT FROM CRYPTOCURRENCY AND BUILD YOUR FORTUNE.” Another slide states that viewers can qualify for exclusive packages by building their own sales team.
visual.context: The sampled visuals use a presenter-led business or education presentation format. The relationship between the profit claims, package qualification, and audience participation is presented visually but the full offer and surrounding explanation are not available.
visual.potential_relevance: The video visibly links promised profitability or package qualification with a recruitment-related action, namely building a sales team, which conditionally merits review as a reward-and-action relationship.
visual.limitations: These sparse frames do not establish whether money, cryptocurrency, personal data, or other assets are requested; they do not show transaction steps, eligibility details, actual returns, or whether the statements are promotional claims, quotations, or an educational example.
